La Monnaie, la Terre et le Mérite

Trois réformes dures pour un Cameroun qui se construit

A manifesto for Cameroonian decision makers in three books: the money (move the franc CFA from cash to digital, without changing the currency), the land (agriculture, industry under export discipline, finance in their service, as East Asia did) and merit (the value is subjective, a country belongs to no one, tribalism and nepotism are bad economics). Forty-two chapters, a letter to decision makers and the e-XAF interactive demonstrator.

William Foteping · 45 sections · 152,178 words · about 692 minutes
